items.question: 荆棘中的种子是谁？
items.standard_answer: Hear word, choked by life's cares.

items.generated_answer_english: The seed among thorns is those who hear the word, but the devil comes and takes the word from their hearts, so they do not believe and are not saved.
items.llm_rationale: Generated answer correctly identifies seed as those who hear word but are choked by devil, matching standard answer.
items.llm_english_rationale: Generated answer correctly identifies seed as those who hear word but are choked by devil, matching standard answer.
